name: Introduction to Diversity Management
description:
Project Week: Hackathon - Hacking TUM for Diversity!
Join us for the Diversity Hackathon, an exciting, hands-on opportunity to collaborate, innovate, and address challenges related to diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) within - and beyond! - the TUM community.

This event welcomes students from all academic disciplines and backgrounds to come together and develop creative, impactful solutions for a more inclusive and equitable campus. Whether you're a coder, designer, strategist, or simply passionate about creating positive change, this hackathon values your unique perspective and skills.

Through team-based brainstorming and problem-solving, participants will explore real-world DEI challenges, network with like-minded peers, and contribute to shaping TUM’s future. Together, we can drive innovation and inspire action for a more inclusive tomorrow.

Let’s build a better TUM—together!
